races.name: Ultimate Builder
notes: Ultimate Builder is treated as a meta-race in clean v1: it aggregates starter buildings from all normalized races.
Only the unique builder layer and the Ultimate-specific discharge tower are normalized here; inherited line buildings stay owned by their home race modules.
Unique discharge-related abilities are normalized to readable editor names.
